problem: An authorized Netlify deploy could enter provider state=error while Production Source Snapshot spent ten minutes waiting only for release.json to expose the expected SHA.
root_cause: The workflow treated successful deploy submission as if the provider build were still progressing and did not retain deployId/buildId for provider-state readback.
prevention: Capture Netlify deployId and buildId from the authorized deploy transport output.
Poll the provider deploy object before the release.json identity loop.
On provider state=error, read only a bounded sanitized set of deploy/build metadata and fail immediately.
Never print the OIDC-returned Netlify proxy or provider secrets.
Only proceed to exact production SHA and pricing/i18n browser proof after the provider deploy reports ready.
